Delhi High Court Orders Restoration of Cockroach Janta Party's Social Media Account

The Delhi High Court has ordered the restoration of Cockroach Janta Party's social media account, revoking the Centre's blocking order. The court's decision comes after a petition was filed by party leader Abhijit Dipak on behalf of his client, who is a member of the party. The court's ruling is seen as a victory for free speech and the right to express dissenting views.
